title: Lennox Declares Quarterly Dividend
summary: The Investor Relations website contains information about Lennox's business for stockholders, potential investors, and financial analysts.
body_markdown:
## Lennox Declares Quarterly Dividend


September 18, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investor.lennox.com/node/30216/pdf)


DALLAS


, Sept. 18, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- The Lennox (NYSE: LII) board of directors approved a quarterly cash dividend of $1.36 per share of common stock, payable October 15, 2026, to stockholders of record as of September 30, 2026.


**About Lennox**
Lennox (NYSE: LII) is a leader in energy-efficient building solutions and is committed to creating healthier and more comfortable environments. Serving residential and commercial customers, the company delivers innovative heating, cooling, indoor air quality, refrigeration, and water heating systems. Through trusted products, parts, and services, and advanced technology, Lennox delivers connected solutions that support the full lifecycle of customer needs. Additional information is available at[www.lennox.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4775074-1&h=2697215960&u=https%3A%2F%2Fedge.prnewswire.com%2Fc%2Flink%2F%3Ft%3D0%26l%3Den%26o%3D4694274-1%26h%3D1838633415%26u%3Dhttps%253A%252F%252Fwww.lennox.com%252F%26a%3Dwww.lennox.com&a=www.lennox.com) .
